products.name: Chì Xiá — Crimson Glow
products.description: A warm, magnetic scent built to draw connection close — pink pepper opens bright, tuberose and carnation bloom into something bolder, and amber with tonka bean settle into a lingering, skin-warm base. Composed around Fire and Earth, the elements that govern passion and grounded intimacy in the Five Element tradition.

products.name: Jīn Liú — Golden Flow
products.description: A crisp, clarifying opening of bergamot and yuzu gives way to clary sage, then settles into musk and ambergris — smooth, quiet, and expansive. Composed around Metal and Water, the elements associated with clarity, precision, and the flow of abundance.

products.name: Běi Chén — North Star
products.description: Cool eucalyptus opens into iris and fig, grounding into vetiver and oud — a scent for steady ambition and forward motion. Composed around Water and Wood, the elements tied to direction, wisdom, and growth.

products.name: Qīng Líng — Verdant Calm
products.description: Basil and lavender open fresh and herbal, geranium and violet soften at the heart, and vanilla with cashmeran ground it all in warmth. Composed around Wood and Earth, the elements governing vitality, growth, and ease in the body.

products.name: Wǔ Xíng — Five Elements
products.description: Our signature blend, touching every element at once — bergamot and peppermint at the top, rose and honey at the heart, amber and sandalwood at the base. A complete, balancing scent for whenever your chart needs a little of everything.

products.name: Personalized Chu Wu Blend
products.description: Perfect for first-time users or daily carry. Crafted around your elemental balance — every bottle is custom-made after your order is confirmed.
